text: Implemented schema-bound DesignDiagnostics with one explicit SVD cutoff for rank and pinv components; VIF aliases/constants, independent nonadditive block R2, min-norm standardized joint coefficients, schema fingerprint/row receipts, and correlationMapEither reuse. Added NumPy-generated analytic fixtures and JVM+JS shared suite. Awaiting parent combined design gate because concurrent SF4 source currently requires its dependency update.
